data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order: From/To autocomplete, depart date, Passengers/Class counts and cabin, Confirm, Show flights, then select a fare, and it names the right parameters. Points come off for a few smaller problems: it lists the cabin options as Economy/Premium when the actual choice was Business/First; it adds steps and parameters that don't apply (choosing a tab, a date-picker Continue button, trip type); and it doesn't show that fare selection happened twice.
